heading: Absence of Director
lead: In the case of the absence of the Director of the National Institute of Standards and Technology the Secretary of Commerce may designate some officer of said Institute to perform the duties of the director during his absence.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was not enacted as part of the National Institute of Standards and Technology Act which comprises this chapter.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1988—Pub. L. 100–418 substituted “National Institute of Standards and Technology” for “Bureau of Standards” and “Institute” for “bureau”.

notes.heading: Change of Name
notes.text: Act Mar. 4, 1913, substituted “Secretary of Commerce” for “Secretary of Commerce and Labor”.

ancestors.heading: NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF STANDARDS AND TECHNOLOGY
